scope: Live graph and placement identity only; final routing completion and clock timing are separate checks.

topology.comparison: Exact named cell/type/parameters/primitive port shape/direction/connectivity, plus all eleven top IO cell directions/pad nets/BELs, with bijective reference-wire to live-net-name mapping
topology.top_interface_evidence: Pinned live API omits ctx.ports. Reference top-port metadata is bound to its exact TRELLIS_IO DIR/B connection; all eleven live pad net names and physical IO locations match.

physical_settings_evidence: Pinned live API omits ctx.settings. Runner must bind the explicit same-process CLI and strict final 100/25 MHz timing; this hook does not claim a settings snapshot.
clock_action: Restore exact global clocks before routing
